mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exams ( class_id, -- 반 ID exam_name, -- 시험명 subject, -- 과목명 exam_date, -- 시험일 total_score, -- 만점 created_by -- 등록자 ID ) VALUES ( #{classId}, #{examName}, #{subject}, #{examDate}, #{totalScore}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT e.exam_id, -- 시험 ID e.class_id, -- 반 ID c.class_name, -- 반 이름 e.exam_name, -- 시험명 e.subject, -- 과목명 e.exam_date, -- 시험일 e.total_score, -- 만점 e.created_at -- 등록일시 FROM exams e JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id
e.class_id = #{classId}
AND e.subject ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, e.exam_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE exams SET class_id = #{classId}, -- 반 ID 수정 exam_name = #{examName}, -- 시험명 수정 subject = #{subject}, -- 과목 수정 exam_date = #{examDate}, -- 시험일 수정 total_score = #{totalScore} -- 만점 수정 WHERE exam_id = #{examId} -- 수정 대상 시험 ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grades ( exam_id, -- 시험 ID student_id, -- 학생 ID score, -- 점수 rank_no, -- 석차 comment -- 비고 ) VALUES ( #{examId}, #{studentId}, #{score}, #{rankNo}, #{comment} )
mapper.update: UPDATE grades SET score = #{score}, -- 점수 수정 rank_no = #{rankNo}, -- 석차 수정 comment = #{comment}, -- 비고 수정 updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP -- 수정일시 갱신 WHERE grade_id = #{gradeId} -- 수정 대상 성적 ID
mapper.select: SELECT total_score FROM exams WHERE exam_id = #{examId}

SELECT u.name AS student_name, c.class_name, e.exam_name FROM exams e JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = #{studentId} JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.update: UPDATE grades g SET rank_no = ranked.rank_no, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT grade_id, CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS INTEGER) AS rank_no FROM grades WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ) ranked WHERE g.grade_id = ranked.grade_id
mapper.select: SELECT g.grade_id, -- 성적 ID g.exam_id, -- 시험 ID g.student_id, -- 학생 ID u.name AS student_name, -- 학생 이름 s.student_no, -- 학생 관리번호 g.score, -- 점수 g.rank_no, -- 석차 g.comment -- 비고 FROM grades g JOIN students s ON s.student_id = g.student_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE g.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY u.name
SELECT s.student_id FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId}

SELECT s.student_id, u_student.name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.school_name, s.grade_level, sp.relation_code, sp.primary_yn FROM student_parents sp JOIN parents p ON p.parent_id = sp.parent_id JOIN users u_parent ON u_parent.user_id = p.user_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = sp.student_id JOIN users u_student ON u_student.user_id = s.user_id WHERE u_parent.login_id = #{loginId} ORDER BY sp.primary_yn DESC, u_student.name, s.student_id
SELECT DISTINCT e.subject FROM exams e WHERE e.subject IS NOT NULL AND e.subject != '' ORDER BY e.subject

SELECT c.class_id, -- 반 ID c.class_name, -- 반 이름 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT en.student_id) FROM enrollments en WHERE en.class_id = c.class_id AND en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ) AS student_count, -- 현재 수강 학생 수 COUNT(g.grade_id) AS grade_count, -- 입력된 성적 수 ROUND(AVG(g.score), 1) AS average_score, -- 평균 점수 MAX(g.score) AS highest_score, -- 최고점 MIN(g.score) AS lowest_score, -- 최저점 ROUND(AVG((g.score / NULLIF(e.total_score, 0)) * 100), 1) AS average_rate -- 만점 대비 평균 비율 FROM classes c JOIN exams e ON e.class_id = c.class_id JOIN grades g ON g.exam_id = e.exam_id
c.class_id = #{classId}
AND e.subject ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
GROUP BY c.class_id, c.class_name ORDER BY c.class_name

SELECT e.exam_id, -- 시험 ID s.student_id, -- 학생 ID u.name AS student_name, -- 학생 이름 s.student_no, -- 학생 관리번호 g.grade_id, -- 성적 ID, 없으면 NULL g.score, -- 점수, 없으면 NULL g.rank_no, -- 석차, 없으면 NULL g.comment -- 비고, 없으면 NULL FROM exams e JOIN enrollments en ON en.class_id = e.class_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = en.student_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN grades g ON g.exam_id = e.exam_id AND g.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId} AND en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name, s.student_id
SELECT class_id, class_name, subject FROM classes ORDER BY class_name, class_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, u.name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.school_name, s.grade_level FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN enrollments en ON en.student_id = s.student_id WHERE en.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name, s.student_id
